body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Panasonic introduced the world's first ultra-zoom HDD camcorder 'SDR-H80' at the 2009 International Consumer Electronics Show.

It features the world's first and most powerful 70x optical ultra-zoom lens. And it also includes an advanced Optical Image Stabilization(O.I.S.) system which helps reduce blur caused by a shaky hand and Panasonic's proprietary Intelligent Auto(iA) technologies, making the camcorders easy to use.
The SDR-H80 also supports easy YouTube upload, quick start mode and easy copy to DVD.
Coming in four colors including silver, black, red and blue, the SDR-H80 is expected to be available for $449.95 in April 2009.
